title: 15 of our favorite sci-fi audiobooks to transport you to another planet
summary: From Andy Weir's heroic protagonists to Octavia E. Butler's epic ideas of biological agency, these audiobooks will blow your mind wide open.
contentText:
The world of science fiction books is vast and inspiring, with tales of distant planets and alien life transporting you into a new world to get lost in. It's the perfect genre for audiobooks, whether you like listening on the sofa, on a walk or on your daily commute, these books can fill you with wonder about the possibilities of our modern scientific age.

We have tales of sentient rocks, long-term alien invasions and deep pining for our home, Earth . My favorite book on this list is Jeff Vandermeer's Annihilation because it made me realise how alien life on our own planet is and I think about it every time I go out into the wilderness. I have read it multiple times and am excited to listen to it on audiobook to gain an even deeper understanding of it.
